rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese noun for a photograph or photo.

example.english: This photograph turned out really nice.
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 jing2 dak1 gei2 leng3 wo3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for taking a photograph of someone or something.

example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 jing2 soeng2

rows.note: Use this for someone who appears attractive or photogenic in photographs.

example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 joeng6 hou2 soeng5 geng3
